statement: ∀ (i j : Fin 3), ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)).coord i) ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)) j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
script:
# name: la-dual-basis-delta-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances the kernel checks by computation (test_fallback)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Linear.dual_basis_delta file "la-dual-basis-delta-test.sage"
# description: every one of the 9 instances (i, j) of e^i(e_j) = δ^i_j on ℝ³, by evaluation (exhaustive).
SEED = 0  # EDIT: the sampler's seed, kept in the test record
PROOF = 'simp [Pi.single_apply]'  # EDIT: the tactic block proving the claim at one instance
CASES = [  # EDIT: the instances as ([values as Lean text], edge?[, proof]) tuples
    (['0', '0'], True),
    (['0', '1'], False),
    (['0', '2'], False),
    (['1', '0'], False),
    (['1', '1'], False),
    (['1', '2'], False),
    (['2', '0'], False),
    (['2', '1'], False),
    (['2', '2'], False),
]
cases = CASES
instances = [kernel_instance(*c[0], proof=c[2] if len(c) > 2 else PROOF, edge=c[1]) for c in cases]

goal.text: ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)).coord i) ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)) j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
